$comment: GENERATED by wp/tests/wp-integration/mcp_abilities.sh from the abilities a running site registers (Pro on). Do not edit: WRITE_REGISTRY=1 regenerates it, and the harness fails when this file differs from the site.

mcp.auth: a WordPress application password (HTTP) or --user (WP-CLI); the user needs the capability each ability names
mcp.switch: Settings: Allow AI agents (MCP), on by default

rest.run: /wp-json/wp-abilities/v1/abilities/<name>/run  (GET with ?input= for read-only abilities, POST {"input": {...}} otherwise)

abilities.name: pbs/activate-custom-font
abilities.label: Turn on an uploaded font (Pro)
abilities.description: Makes an uploaded custom font (a font file in the media library, by id) available in the font pickers.

abilities.name: pbs/add-local-font
abilities.label: Self-host a font
abilities.description: Downloads a Google font family (family, weights, italic) and serves it from this site.

abilities.name: pbs/add-section
abilities.label: Add a section to a page
abilities.description: Adds a ready-made section to a page: at the start, at the end, or after the section at a given position.

section.description: The name of a section in this site's section library.

after.description: With position "after": the 0-based position of the section to insert after.

abilities.name: pbs/add-shop-block
abilities.label: Add a product block or mini cart (Pro)
abilities.description: Adds a WooCommerce block at the end of a post: a product element (part: title, gallery, image, price, rating, excerpt, description, add_to_cart, meta, tabs, related, upsells, sale_badge, stock; productId, or 0 for the product being viewed) or a mini cart (label).

abilities.name: pbs/ai-check-accessibility
abilities.label: Check a page's accessibility
abilities.description: Lists a page's accessibility problems: images without alt text, headings that skip a level, links whose text says nothing on its own, and links with no text. Each says whether it can be fixed automatically.

abilities.name: pbs/ai-create-block
abilities.label: Create a custom block with AI
abilities.description: Designs a reusable component from a description (a pricing card, a team card, a banner) and saves it as a synced pattern in the editor's "My patterns", with each text overridable per placement. Returns its id and the block that places it.
abilities.capability: edit_posts and publish_posts; the AI settings' role and spending rules

abilities.name: pbs/ai-css-help
abilities.label: Explain, write or fix CSS with AI
abilities.description: Explains, writes or fixes the custom CSS of one element, where `selector` stands for the element. Returns the CSS and an explanation; nothing is saved.
abilities.capability: edit_posts and the builder's code permission

abilities.name: pbs/ai-design-from
abilities.label: Design a page from a screenshot or a link with AI
abilities.description: Recreates the layout of a screenshot (an image in the media library) or of a public web page (its address) as editable blocks in a new draft page: the same sections, columns, headings, text, lists and buttons. Logos and images are not copied.
abilities.capability: edit_pages (edit_post on the screenshot); the AI settings' role and spending rules

abilities.name: pbs/ai-edit-page
abilities.label: Edit a page with the AI assistant
abilities.description: Changes a page as asked in plain words ("make the hero text shorter", "add an FAQ about delivery after the pricing", "translate the page into German"). AI answers with edit operations that are checked against the page's blocks and their settings before anything is applied; refused operations are listed with the reason. A revision is saved first and its id returned as undo_revision.
abilities.capability: edit_post on the page; the AI settings' role and spending rules

abilities.name: pbs/ai-fix-accessibility
abilities.label: Fix a page's accessibility with AI
abilities.description: Fixes the accessibility problems that can be fixed (all, or the listed issue ids): alt text written by looking at each image, heading levels corrected, vague link texts rewritten. A revision is saved first and its id returned as undo_revision.
abilities.capability: edit_post on the page; the AI settings' role and spending rules

abilities.name: pbs/ai-generate-image
abilities.label: Generate an image with AI
abilities.description: Creates an image from a description with the site's image model (OpenAI or Google) and saves it to the media library with alt text. Returns its id and address.
abilities.capability: upload_files; the AI settings' role and spending rules

abilities.name: pbs/ai-generate-section
abilities.label: Generate a section with AI
abilities.description: Turns a one-sentence description into a ready-designed section (real, editable blocks in the site's brand style) with text written for it. Returns the block markup, and adds it to the start or end of a page when a post_id is given (a revision keeps what was there before).
abilities.capability: edit_posts; edit_post to add it to a page; the AI settings' role and spending rules

abilities.name: pbs/ai-plan-site
abilities.label: Plan a website with AI
abilities.description: From a description of the business, lists the pages a website needs (home first, contact last), each with a title and a brief for that page. Nothing is created; each page can then be built from its brief.
abilities.capability: edit_pages; the AI settings' role and spending rules

abilities.name: pbs/ai-save-seo-meta
abilities.label: Save an SEO title and description
abilities.description: Saves a meta title and description into the SEO plugin the site uses (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress or All in One SEO) and says which ones were written.

abilities.name: pbs/ai-suggest-seo-meta
abilities.label: Suggest an SEO title and description with AI
abilities.description: Reads a page and suggests a meta title (up to 60 characters) and meta description (up to 155), optionally around a focus keyword. Nothing is saved.
abilities.capability: edit_post on the page; the AI settings' role and spending rules

abilities.name: pbs/ai-undo
abilities.label: Undo an AI change
abilities.description: Puts a page back the way it was before an AI change, from the undo_revision that change returned.

abilities.name: pbs/ai-write-alt-text
abilities.label: Write image alt text with AI
abilities.description: Looks at images and saves alt text for them: one image (attachment_id), or every image on a page that has none (post_id). At most 20 images per call; the answer says how many remain.
abilities.capability: upload_files and edit_post on the image or page; the AI settings' role and spending rules

abilities.name: pbs/ai-write-text
abilities.label: Write or rewrite text with AI
abilities.description: Writes new text, or improves, shortens, expands, changes the tone of or fixes the grammar of a piece of text, with the site's own AI provider. Returns the new text; nothing on the site is changed.
abilities.capability: edit_posts (edit_post when post_id is given); the AI settings' role and spending rules

abilities.name: pbs/apply-brand-kit
abilities.label: Apply the brand kit (Pro)
abilities.description: Applies the saved brand kit's colours and fonts to the site design.

abilities.name: pbs/apply-kit
abilities.label: Import a website kit
abilities.description: Imports a website kit's pages (all of them, or the ones named), optionally publishing them, setting the home page and adding them to a menu. Importing again updates the same pages.
abilities.capability: edit_pages and publish_pages; manage_options to set the home page

abilities.name: pbs/apply-replace
abilities.label: Apply a find-and-replace (Pro)
abilities.description: Applies a previewed job. Every changed post keeps a backup, so the job can be undone.

abilities.name: pbs/build-landing-page
abilities.label: Build a landing page
abilities.description: A guided workflow: the agent picks sections that fit your business, builds the page as a draft and writes its text.

business.description: The business, its offer and its audience.

abilities.name: pbs/build-pages
abilities.label: Build several pages
abilities.description: Creates up to 50 pages in one call, each from sections and/or block content. Each page is checked and created on its own; the answer lists every page made and every one refused, with the reason.
abilities.capability: edit_pages; each page is checked on its own (publish_pages to publish)

sections.description: Names of sections in this site's section library, in page order. They come before any content given.

content.description: Block markup (the format the block editor saves).

abilities.name: pbs/check-performance
abilities.label: Check a page's performance
abilities.description: Reports what a page's content adds to its weight: its images (bytes, oversized ones and the smaller size that would do), the stylesheets of the blocks it uses and its third-party embeds, each problem with its fix.

abilities.name: pbs/connect-adobe-fonts
abilities.label: Connect Adobe Fonts (Pro)
abilities.description: Connects an Adobe Fonts (Typekit) web project by its kit id, so its fonts appear in the font pickers.

abilities.name: pbs/connect-marketing-service
abilities.label: Connect a mailing-list service (Pro)
abilities.description: Connects a mailing-list service with its API key (service, key; account where the service needs one), or disconnects it with an empty key.

abilities.name: pbs/connect-support
abilities.label: Connect to support
abilities.description: Connects this site to Zinn Digital® support (name, email, consent).

abilities.name: pbs/convert-builder-export
abilities.label: Convert an export from another builder (Pro)
abilities.description: Converts an export (builder: elementor, divi, beaver or wpbakery; content: the exported text) into a new draft page made of blocks, optionally copying its images into the media library (media). Answers with the draft and a conversion report.

abilities.name: pbs/convert-builder-page
abilities.label: Convert a page from another builder (Pro)
abilities.description: Converts one page built with Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder or WPBakery (id) into a new draft made of blocks, keeping its layout, typography, colours and images; the original page is not changed. Answers with the draft and a report of what was converted, approximated or not converted. dryRun converts without saving.
abilities.capability: edit_pages and edit_post (the REST route's own check)

abilities.name: pbs/convert-post
abilities.label: Convert one legacy page
abilities.description: Converts one 5.x page to blocks (backed up first).
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: pbs/create-ab-test
abilities.label: Create an A/B test (Pro)
abilities.description: Adds a test of two versions of a section to the end of a post (post, name, a, b; split and goal optional).

abilities.name: pbs/create-class
abilities.label: Create a global class (Pro)
abilities.description: Creates a reusable global style class: label, slug and its styles (s).

abilities.name: pbs/create-cookie-banner
abilities.label: Create a starter cookie banner (Pro)
abilities.description: Creates a ready-made consent banner design to start from.

abilities.name: pbs/create-form
abilities.label: Create a form (Pro)
abilities.description: Creates a form (contact, quote, signup or multi-step: fields, steps, settings and actions such as email, save, webhook or a mailing list), on a new page or at the end of an existing post (post).

condition.description: Show this field only when another field (fieldId: its name) matches: eq, neq, contains, empty or notempty, against value.

abilities.name: pbs/create-page
abilities.label: Create a page
abilities.description: Creates a page from library sections and/or block content. A new page is a draft unless another status is asked for.
abilities.capability: edit_pages; publish_pages to publish or make private

sections.description: Names of sections in this site's section library, in page order. They come before any content given.

content.description: Block markup (the format the block editor saves).

abilities.name: pbs/create-popup
abilities.label: Create a popup (Pro)
abilities.description: Creates a popup, slide-in or bar: its content, trigger (exit intent, scroll, time, click), frequency and the pages it shows on.

abilities.name: pbs/create-query-loop
abilities.label: Add a query loop (Pro)
abilities.description: Adds a query loop with a ready-made card, on a new page (pageTitle, status) or at the end of a post (post): source posts|users|terms|field, postType (product for a shop grid), perPage, columns, orderBy, order, pagination, and live filters [{type: search|taxonomy|meta|sort|price|onsale|instock, taxonomy, key, label, ui}].
abilities.capability: edit_post and edit_posts (the REST route's own check)

abilities.name: pbs/create-team
abilities.label: Create a library team (Agency)
abilities.description: Creates a team library (name) that other sites can join with an invite code.

abilities.name: pbs/create-theme-template
abilities.label: Create a theme template (Pro)
abilities.description: Creates a template (title, type) that replaces that part of every matching page, on classic and block themes. Without content it starts from a ready-made design for its type. include/exclude are display-condition rules ({kind, values, key, value, from, to, days}, the kinds this site's theme builder offers); priority breaks ties; status publish (live) or draft.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: pbs/deactivate-custom-font
abilities.label: Turn off an uploaded font (Pro)
abilities.description: Removes a custom font (by slug) from the font pickers.

abilities.name: pbs/delete-class
abilities.label: Delete a global class (Pro)
abilities.description: Deletes a global class. Elements that used it keep their content and lose its styles.

abilities.name: pbs/delete-icon
abilities.label: Delete an uploaded icon
abilities.description: Removes an uploaded icon; blocks that used it keep their own copy.

abilities.name: pbs/delete-library-item
abilities.label: Delete a cloud library design (Pro)
abilities.description: Deletes a design from the cloud library.

abilities.name: pbs/delete-page
abilities.label: Move a page to the trash
abilities.description: Moves a page to the trash. It can be restored from Pages, Trash for 30 days.

abilities.name: pbs/delete-team
abilities.label: Delete a library team (Agency)
abilities.description: Deletes a team and every design in its library.

abilities.name: pbs/delete-theme-template
abilities.label: Delete a theme template (Pro)
abilities.description: Moves one template (id) to the trash; the theme's own design shows again where it applied. Restorable from the trash.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: pbs/disconnect-support
abilities.label: Disconnect from support
abilities.description: Disconnects this site from support.

abilities.name: pbs/duplicate-class
abilities.label: Duplicate a global class (Pro)
abilities.description: Copies a global class under a new id.

abilities.name: pbs/duplicate-page
abilities.label: Duplicate a page
abilities.description: Copies a page (its title, content and template) into a new draft.
abilities.capability: edit_post on the page and edit_pages

abilities.name: pbs/export-designs
abilities.label: Export designs and settings
abilities.description: Exports the chosen templates and patterns (ids) and, optionally, settings as one package for another site.

abilities.name: pbs/find-builder-pages
abilities.label: Find pages built with other builders (Pro)
abilities.description: Lists the pages and posts built with Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder or WPBakery (page, per_page), each with its builder and, when it was converted before, the converted draft.

abilities.name: pbs/generate-page
abilities.label: Write a page with AI
abilities.description: Builds a page from sections (given, or chosen by AI from the section library) and has AI rewrite all of its text for your brief, keeping the design. Uses the AI provider set up in the plugin's AI settings. The page is a draft unless another status is asked for.
abilities.capability: edit_pages; publish_pages to publish; the AI settings' role and spending rules

brief.description: What the page is for: the business, the offer, the audience and the tone.

abilities.name: pbs/get-block
abilities.label: Describe a builder block
abilities.description: Returns one block's settings (attributes with their types, choices and defaults), what it supports, which blocks it may contain, and a ready-to-use example in block markup.

abilities.name: pbs/get-breakpoints
abilities.label: Read the responsive breakpoints
abilities.description: Returns the tablet and mobile widths (and custom breakpoints in Pro) the responsive controls use.

abilities.name: pbs/get-conversion-tracking
abilities.label: Read the conversion tracking (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns the Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and Meta Pixel settings and which clicks and form submissions are sent.

abilities.name: pbs/get-cookie-banner
abilities.label: Read the cookie consent banner (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns the consent banner: whether it is on, its text and design, the categories, and where it applies.

abilities.name: pbs/get-design-globals
abilities.label: Read the site design
abilities.description: Returns the site-wide colours and fonts (heading and body) every block uses, as the Site design screen shows them.

abilities.name: pbs/get-design-system
abilities.label: Read the design system (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns the Pro design system: global classes, variables, design tokens, dark mode, brand kit and custom fonts.

abilities.name: pbs/get-diagnostics
abilities.label: Read the site diagnostics
abilities.description: Returns the diagnostics a support ticket would carry: versions, active plugins, limits and recent errors.

abilities.name: pbs/get-figma-connection
abilities.label: Read the Figma connection (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns whether the site has a Figma personal access token, the Figma account it belongs to and its last four characters. The token itself is never returned.

abilities.name: pbs/get-library-account
abilities.label: Read the cloud library account (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns the cloud library's storage use, plan quota and team facts.

abilities.name: pbs/get-library-item
abilities.label: Get a cloud library design (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns one saved design, ready to insert on this site (its images brought into the media library).

abilities.name: pbs/get-library-storage
abilities.label: Read the own-storage settings (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns the bring-your-own R2/S3 storage settings (the secret is never returned).

abilities.name: pbs/get-licence
abilities.label: Read the licence
abilities.description: Returns this site's Page Builder Sandwich plan, licence state, renewal date and what the plan includes.

abilities.name: pbs/get-maintenance
abilities.label: Read maintenance mode (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns maintenance / coming-soon mode: mode, page, retry-after and which roles still see the site.

abilities.name: pbs/get-migration
abilities.label: Read the legacy migration
abilities.description: Returns the 5.x content conversion's progress and report.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: pbs/get-motion-options
abilities.label: List the animation and interaction settings (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns every motion setting (entrance animation, its length and delay, scroll effect, hover effect, stay in view, parallax, follow the pointer) with its choices or range, and the site's breakpoints.

abilities.name: pbs/get-newsletter-keys
abilities.label: Read the newsletter connection (Pro)
abilities.description: Says whether a Mailchimp key is saved (the key itself is never returned).

abilities.name: pbs/get-page
abilities.label: Read a page
abilities.description: Returns a page's title, status, links and block content, and the sections (top-level blocks) it is made of.

abilities.name: pbs/get-replace-job
abilities.label: Preview a find-and-replace (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns a job's matches, page by page, to review before applying.

abilities.name: pbs/get-reviews-sources
abilities.label: Read the reviews sources (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns the Google and Trustpilot sources the Reviews block shows.

abilities.name: pbs/get-roles
abilities.label: Read builder permissions (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns which roles may use the builder, design, code and templates (client mode).

abilities.name: pbs/get-settings
abilities.label: Read the plugin settings
abilities.description: Returns the front-end class prefix, the beta-updates state and whether AI agents (MCP) are allowed.

abilities.name: pbs/get-structured-data
abilities.label: Read a page's structured data
abilities.description: Lists the schema.org structured data a page's blocks print (FAQ, How-To, Product, Review, Breadcrumb) and which types are left to the site's SEO plugin so nothing is printed twice.

abilities.name: pbs/get-support-connection
abilities.label: Read the support connection
abilities.description: Says whether this site is connected to Zinn Digital® support, and as whom.

abilities.name: pbs/get-theme-builder-options
abilities.label: Read the theme builder's choices (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns the template types, the display-condition kinds (page, post type, term, archive, search, 404, logged in, role, device, date, time, URL parameter, referrer, language, cart) with their choices on this site (roles, languages, post types, taxonomies), and the block attribute (pbswConditions: {match, rules}) that shows or hides any block.

abilities.name: pbs/get-white-label
abilities.label: Read white label (Agency)
abilities.description: Returns the white-label settings: on or off, the name shown and which users still see the original.

abilities.name: pbs/import-designs
abilities.label: Import designs and settings
abilities.description: Imports a Page Builder Sandwich design package (dryRun first to see what would change; mode: skip or replace; media; settings).

abilities.name: pbs/import-figma-frame
abilities.label: Import a Figma frame (Pro)
abilities.description: Imports one Figma frame (url: the frame's link, with its node-id) into a new draft page made of blocks: auto layout becomes flex and grid containers, text keeps its fonts and sizes, images are copied into the media library. Uses the site's own Figma token. Answers with the draft and a conversion report.
abilities.capability: edit_pages and upload_files (the REST route's own check)

abilities.name: pbs/invite-team-member
abilities.label: Invite a site to a team (Agency)
abilities.description: Creates a single-use invite code (role: read or write; label; days valid). The code is shown once.

abilities.name: pbs/join-team
abilities.label: Join a team (Pro)
abilities.description: Joins a team library with an invite code.

abilities.name: pbs/leave-team
abilities.label: Leave a team (Pro)
abilities.description: Leaves the team library this site joined.

abilities.name: pbs/list-ab-tests
abilities.label: List the A/B tests and their results (Pro)
abilities.description: Lists the A/B tests with each version's visitors and conversions, and which one is winning.

abilities.name: pbs/list-blocks
abilities.label: List the builder blocks
abilities.description: Lists every Page Builder Sandwich block this site can use (Pro blocks too when Pro is active): name, title, category and description.

abilities.name: pbs/list-dynamic-sources
abilities.label: List the dynamic content sources (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns what a block can be filled from (post, author, site, archive, custom field, product) with each source's fields, the field plugins on this site (ACF, Meta Box, Pods, JetEngine, Toolset, post meta) and a post type's fields (postType). A block is bound to a source through its attributes.metadata.bindings, one {source, args} per attribute.

abilities.name: pbs/list-extensions
abilities.label: List the builder's add-on extensions
abilities.description: Lists what other plugins have added to Page Builder Sandwich through its developer API: blocks, dynamic data sources, display conditions and form actions, each with its name, label and plugin.

abilities.name: pbs/list-form-submissions
abilities.label: Read form submissions (Pro)
abilities.description: Lists what visitors sent through the forms that save submissions (form narrows it), a page at a time.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: pbs/list-forms
abilities.label: List forms
abilities.description: Lists the forms built with the Form block and the form plugins it can embed.

abilities.name: pbs/list-kits
abilities.label: List website kits
abilities.description: Lists the website kits (a set of ready-made pages for one kind of business) this site can import.

abilities.name: pbs/list-library-items
abilities.label: List cloud library designs (Pro)
abilities.description: Lists the designs saved to the cloud library (kind: section, page or pattern; team: a team's library).

abilities.name: pbs/list-local-fonts
abilities.label: List self-hosted fonts
abilities.description: Lists the Google fonts this site hosts itself (downloaded once, served from the site, no request to Google).

abilities.name: pbs/list-lottie
abilities.label: List Lottie animations (Pro)
abilities.description: Lists the uploaded Lottie animations.

abilities.name: pbs/list-marketing-connections
abilities.label: List the mailing-list connections (Pro)
abilities.description: Lists the mailing-list services (Mailchimp, Brevo, MailerLite, Kit, ActiveCampaign) and which are connected. Keys are never returned.

abilities.name: pbs/list-marketing-forms
abilities.label: List the form-builder forms (Pro)
abilities.description: Lists every form made with the form builder: the page it is on, its fields and what happens when it is sent.

abilities.name: pbs/list-marketing-lists
abilities.label: List a service's mailing lists (Pro)
abilities.description: Lists the audiences or lists of a connected mailing-list service, for a form's subscribe action.

abilities.name: pbs/list-pages
abilities.label: List pages
abilities.description: Lists the pages you can edit, newest first, with an optional search.
abilities.capability: edit_pages; only pages the user can edit are listed

search.description: Words to search for in the title and content.

abilities.name: pbs/list-popups
abilities.label: List the popups (Pro)
abilities.description: Lists the popups, slide-ins and bars with their triggers, frequency rules and where they show.

abilities.name: pbs/list-replace-jobs
abilities.label: List find-and-replace jobs (Pro)
abilities.description: Lists the site-wide find-and-replace jobs and their state.

abilities.name: pbs/list-sections
abilities.label: List sections
abilities.description: Lists the ready-made sections (hero, features, FAQ, testimonials, call to action and more) that can be added to a page.

search.description: Words to match in a section's name or keywords.

abilities.name: pbs/list-team-members
abilities.label: List team members (Pro)
abilities.description: Lists the sites in a team and their access.

abilities.name: pbs/list-teams
abilities.label: List library teams (Pro)
abilities.description: Lists the teams this site belongs to or owns.

abilities.name: pbs/list-theme-templates
abilities.label: List the theme templates (Pro)
abilities.description: Lists the theme builder's templates (header, footer, single, archive, search, 404 and, with WooCommerce, product, shop, cart, checkout, thank-you and My Account): each one's type, where it shows (include/exclude rules), priority, status and blocks.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: pbs/list-transferable
abilities.label: List what can be exported
abilities.description: Lists the templates, patterns and settings that can be exported to another site.

abilities.name: pbs/list-uploaded-icons
abilities.label: List uploaded icons
abilities.description: Lists the SVG icons uploaded to the icon library, newest first.

abilities.name: pbs/move-section
abilities.label: Move a section
abilities.description: Moves a section of a page from one position to another (0-based, in the order the page lists them).

abilities.name: pbs/open-support-ticket
abilities.label: Open a support ticket
abilities.description: Files a support ticket (subject, message, kind, email), with this site's diagnostics when the administrator agreed. It never creates a login or sends one.

kind.description: The kind of request; help when omitted.

email.description: Reply address; the connected support email when omitted.

diagnostics.description: True attaches this site's diagnostics (needs the administrator's consent).

abilities.name: pbs/preview-dynamic-value
abilities.label: Preview a dynamic value (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns what a binding shows on one post (post, source, and field or provider + key, as text|url), to check a binding before or after adding it.

abilities.name: pbs/record-support-consent
abilities.label: Consent to support diagnostics
abilities.description: Records the administrator's consent to send diagnostics with support tickets.

consent.description: True records the administrator's consent to send diagnostics with support tickets.

abilities.name: pbs/refresh-reviews
abilities.label: Refresh reviews now (Pro)
abilities.description: Fetches the latest Trustpilot reviews now instead of waiting for the daily refresh.

abilities.name: pbs/remove-block
abilities.label: Remove a block from a page
abilities.description: Removes one block (a whole section, or a block inside one) from a page, found by its path. The page's previous version stays in its revisions.

path.description: Where the block is: its position among the page's sections, then among that block's inner blocks, and so on (0-based), in the order the page lists them.

abilities.name: pbs/remove-library-storage
abilities.label: Stop using your own storage (Pro)
abilities.description: Removes the bring-your-own storage settings; the plan storage is used again.

abilities.name: pbs/remove-local-font
abilities.label: Remove a self-hosted font
abilities.description: Deletes a self-hosted font family's files.

abilities.name: pbs/remove-team-member
abilities.label: Remove a team member (Agency)
abilities.description: Removes a site from a team.

abilities.name: pbs/reset-ab-test
abilities.label: Reset an A/B test's results (Pro)
abilities.description: Clears a test's counts and starts it again (test).

abilities.name: pbs/save-library-item
abilities.label: Save a design to the cloud library (Pro)
abilities.description: Saves block markup (title, kind, markup, styles, tags) to your cloud library or a team's; images are packed with it.

abilities.name: pbs/set-block-motion
abilities.label: Animate a block (Pro)
abilities.description: Sets or removes (null) motion settings on one block of a page, found by its path, at a breakpoint (base by default). Works on any block, including core blocks whose HTML is saved in the page. Visitors who ask for reduced motion never see the movement.

abilities.name: pbs/set-library-storage
abilities.label: Use your own storage (Pro)
abilities.description: Saves bring-your-own storage: provider (r2 or s3), bucket, region, endpoint, prefix, key_id, secret, enabled.

enabled.description: True stores the cloud library in this bucket.

provider.description: Storage provider: Cloudflare R2, Amazon S3 or another S3-compatible service.

secret.description: Secret access key; never returned, and empty keeps the saved one.

abilities.name: pbs/set-maintenance
abilities.label: Change maintenance mode (Pro)
abilities.description: Turns maintenance (503) or coming-soon mode on or off (mode), with the page to show (page_id), retry_after and the roles that bypass it.

abilities.name: pbs/set-newsletter-keys
abilities.label: Connect Mailchimp (Pro)
abilities.description: Saves (or, with an empty value, removes) the Mailchimp API key the newsletter block uses.

abilities.name: pbs/set-reviews-sources
abilities.label: Change the reviews sources (Pro)
abilities.description: Sets the Google place and Trustpilot business the Reviews block reads.

abilities.name: pbs/set-roles
abilities.label: Change builder permissions (Pro)
abilities.description: Sets per role what the builder allows (roles), e.g. a content-only client role.

abilities.name: pbs/set-white-label
abilities.label: Change white label (Agency)
abilities.description: Turns white label on or off and sets the name clients see (enabled, name, agency_users).

name.description: The builder's name shown to clients.

author.description: Author shown on the Plugins screen.

menu_icon.description: Menu icon: a dashicons-* name or an image URL.

hide_plugin.description: True hides the plugin from clients' Plugins screen.

agency_users.description: IDs of the users who always see the real plugin.

abilities.name: pbs/site-health-clean
abilities.label: Clean up what the site health report found
abilities.description: Cleans one kind of finding: revisions (keeps each post's newest 5, deletes older ones), patterns (moves unused synced patterns to the trash), images (a scaled copy WordPress uses; the original is kept), classes (removes unused design classes, kept for restoring). Each run cleans one batch; "more" is true while findings remain.

abilities.name: pbs/site-health-report
abilities.label: Run the site health report
abilities.description: Finds old revisions, synced patterns nothing uses, heavy original images and design classes no page uses. Works in short steps: each run continues where the last one stopped while the status is "scanning"; restart starts over.

abilities.name: pbs/start-migration
abilities.label: Convert legacy content
abilities.description: Starts (or restarts) converting every 5.x page to blocks; each post is backed up first.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: pbs/start-replace
abilities.label: Find and replace across the site (Pro)
abilities.description: Starts a block-safe find-and-replace (find, replace, kind: text, link or colour; match_case; types). Nothing changes until the previewed job is applied.

abilities.name: pbs/start-trial
abilities.label: Start the free Pro trial
abilities.description: Starts the 14-day Page Builder Sandwich Pro trial for this site (no payment needed).

abilities.name: pbs/test-library-storage
abilities.label: Test your own storage (Pro)
abilities.description: Writes, reads and deletes a test object in your own storage and reports each step.

abilities.name: pbs/undo-convert-post
abilities.label: Undo one conversion
abilities.description: Restores one converted page from its backup.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: pbs/undo-migration
abilities.label: Undo the legacy migration
abilities.description: Restores every converted post from its backup.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: pbs/undo-replace
abilities.label: Undo a find-and-replace (Pro)
abilities.description: Restores the posts a job changed (a post edited since keeps its edit).

abilities.name: pbs/update-block
abilities.label: Change one block's settings
abilities.description: Changes the settings (attributes) of one block inside a page, found by its path; attributes you send are merged over the current ones. Works on blocks the site renders from their settings; a block whose HTML is saved in the page is changed by replacing the page's markup.

path.description: Where the block is: its position among the page's sections, then among that block's inner blocks, and so on (0-based), in the order the page lists them.

abilities.name: pbs/update-brand-kit
abilities.label: Change the brand kit (Pro)
abilities.description: Saves the brand kit: name, logo, colours, heading and body fonts, and the brand voice AI writing uses.

abilities.name: pbs/update-breakpoints
abilities.label: Change the responsive breakpoints
abilities.description: Changes the tablet and mobile widths in pixels; with Pro, custom extra breakpoints.

abilities.name: pbs/update-class
abilities.label: Change a global class (Pro)
abilities.description: Changes a global class's label, slug or styles; every element using it updates.

abilities.name: pbs/update-conversion-tracking
abilities.label: Change the conversion tracking (Pro)
abilities.description: Changes the Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and Meta Pixel settings and which events are sent.

loadTags.description: True loads these tags on the site.

formEvent.description: Event name sent when a form is submitted; generate_lead by default.

abilities.name: pbs/update-cookie-banner
abilities.label: Change the cookie consent banner (Pro)
abilities.description: Changes the consent banner. While it is on, tracking scripts wait for the visitor's consent.

popup.description: ID of the popup used as the banner.

handles.description: Script handles held back until a visitor consents.

cookieDays.description: How many days a visitor's choice is remembered.

optOutOutsideEu.description: True: outside the EU, tracking runs until a visitor opts out.

abilities.name: pbs/update-dark-mode
abilities.label: Change dark mode (Pro)
abilities.description: Sets dark mode (mode: off, auto or toggle) and its colours.

abilities.name: pbs/update-design-globals
abilities.label: Change the site design
abilities.description: Changes the site-wide colours (colors), fonts (fonts, headingFont, bodyFont). Every page picks the change up; the theme's theme.json is kept in sync.

abilities.name: pbs/update-form
abilities.label: Change a form (Pro)
abilities.description: Changes one form (post, form): settings and actions merge with what is there; fields (and steps) replace the fields.

condition.description: Show this field only when another field (fieldId: its name) matches: eq, neq, contains, empty or notempty, against value.

abilities.name: pbs/update-page
abilities.label: Update a page
abilities.description: Changes a page's title, status or block content. Content you send replaces the page's content.
abilities.capability: edit_post on that page; publish_pages to publish or make private

sections.description: Names of sections in this site's section library, in page order. They come before any content given.

content.description: Block markup (the format the block editor saves).

abilities.name: pbs/update-popup
abilities.label: Change a popup (Pro)
abilities.description: Changes a popup, slide-in or bar (id): content, trigger, frequency or where it shows.

abilities.name: pbs/update-settings
abilities.label: Change the plugin settings
abilities.description: Changes the front-end class prefix (1 to 8 lowercase letters or digits, starting with a letter) and/or turns AI agents (MCP) on or off (mcp: false removes every ability and the MCP endpoint).

abilities.name: pbs/update-theme-template
abilities.label: Change a theme template (Pro)
abilities.description: Changes one template (id): any of title, type, content (block markup), include, exclude, priority, status. Only what you send changes.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: pbs/update-tokens
abilities.label: Change the design tokens (Pro)
abilities.description: Changes the spacing, radius and shadow scales (space, radius, shadow), or resets them (reset).

abilities.name: pbs/update-variables
abilities.label: Change the CSS variables (Pro)
abilities.description: Replaces the site's design variables (variables: a list of name and value).

abilities.name: pbs/upload-icon
abilities.label: Upload an icon
abilities.description: Adds an SVG icon (name, svg markup) to the icon library; the SVG is sanitised first.

abilities.name: pbs/upload-lottie
abilities.label: Upload a Lottie animation (Pro)
abilities.description: Validates a Lottie JSON document (json, name) and publishes it as a static file for the Lottie block.
